cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Strategic Retreat
cards.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've taken off my club badge like you. A gracious handover; I want you to have room to grow as chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I took mine off to put on the chair's badge. You lost the vote. I need the cupboard key for tonight's match.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, clearing the old equipment. I'm releasing the key so you can practise responsibility.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Remove yourself as administrator too. I can't change the fixtures while you have the override.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll give up the override as well. You should learn to make decisions without my safety net.

reason: Explain B actual badge replacement so A copied removal has a stated model and mistaken interpretation.
